prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: professional editorial blog cover, landscape 3:2. Create an original, tasteful realistic photograph-style illustration of two adult Colombian field-operations coordinators at a bright modern municipal project office, planning a characterization survey on a rugged tablet next to an abstract paper neighborhood map. Screen seen obliquely with anonymous non-legible form shapes, no personal data. Navy and teal restrained institutional colors, natural daylight, believable hands and devices, candid documentary composition, no branding, no words, no watermark. Not an actual customer or endorsement, no uniforms or government seals. Main subject near center to survive cropped blog thumbnails.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial blog cover. Original realistic photograph-style illustration of a small group of diverse adult Colombian residents and a field professional holding a tablet during a respectful community diagnostic conversation in a shaded neighborhood courtyard in the Colombian Caribbean, modest colorful architecture, greenery, natural daylight, comfortable casual professional attire, balanced composition and authentic everyday dignity. All adults, no vulnerable-person stereotypes, no fake government marks, no company logos, no readable screen, no names, no text or watermark. Teal/navy subtle accent colors. This is an illustrative scene, not a real case study.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial blog cover. Original high-end documentary-style illustrative photograph of an adult field technician seated at a clean simple household porch in Colombia speaking respectfully with two adult residents. A tablet held naturally shows indistinct anonymous questionnaire shapes. Warm daylight, plants, authentic Caribbean domestic context, friendly but serious professional interaction, restrained navy and muted green color accents. No minors, no personal papers, no readable data, no signatures on display, no politician, no logos, no uniforms, no text or watermark. Centered composition suitable for website crop. Clearly an illustration, no claim of real customers.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 blog editorial cover. Original sophisticated documentary-style illustrative photograph of an adult community participation workshop in a contemporary Latin American community center. Four adult participants collaboratively point to an abstract large neighborhood map and unlabelled color cards on a table, a facilitator has a tablet. Include women and men of varied adult ages with realistic hands and faces. Daylight, calm teal/navy and warm cream aesthetic, thoughtful professional composition centered on collaboration and map. No election material, no ballots, no government seals, no identifiable data, no words, logos or watermark. Not a real client testimonial.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 professional blog cover. Original premium realistic illustrative photograph of an adult field researcher with a tablet politely interviewing an adult customer at a bright independent small service business reception in a Colombian city. Genuine everyday scene, clean counter, plants, softly blurred urban background, natural sunlight, muted teal and navy accents, balanced central subjects, credible tablet and anatomically correct hands. No banking or medical setting, no transaction details, no uniforms, no real brand or trademark, no readable questionnaire, no text or watermark. No implication this is an actual Control G client.
